given: a warehouse team member is on the stock entry interface and no existing stock record exists for SKU ABC-123 at warehouse location Shelf-A
when: the operator enters SKU ABC-123, location Shelf-A, quantity 50 units, and combined tracking code ABC-123-BAT-SER-001, then submits the filing form
then: the system creates a stock record with SKU=ABC-123, location=Shelf-A, quantity=50, tracking_code=ABC-123-BAT-SER-001, persists it durably, and the operator receives a success confirmation
